Entries.OmniShirt_Description: U kamalak rangli zarrachalar bilan qoplangan!
Entries.BridalShirt_Description: Kelin uchun juda mos, chiroyli oq ko‘ylak.
Entries.OrangeBowShirt_Description: Katta oq bantli, yo‘l-yo‘l to‘q sariq ko‘ylak.
Entries.PourOverShirt_Description: Bu ko‘ylakda tanish zigzag naqsh bor. Hmm... bu hid qayerdan?
Entries.GreenJacketShirt_Description: Yovvoyi o‘rdak patlaridan ilhomlangan. Ko‘ylakni bo‘yash mumkin.
Entries.ShortJacket_Description: Ko‘ylak ustidan kiyiladigan, bo‘yash mumkin bo‘lgan kalta kurtka.
Entries.PolkaDotShirt_Description: Bo‘yash mumkin bo‘lgan nuqtali to‘q rangli ko‘ylak.
Entries.WhiteDotShirt_Description: Oq nuqtali, bo‘yash mumkin bo‘lgan ko‘ylak.
Entries.CamoShirt_Description: Atrof-muhit bilan qorishib ketishga yordam beradi.
Entries.CrabCakeShirt_Description: Mazangiz uchun oldindan aioli sousi surtilgan. Yoqimli ishtaha!
Entries.FadedDenimShirt_Description: Chang bosgan, xiralashgan ko‘rinishdagi denim ko‘ylak.
Entries.TomatoShirt_Description: Katta savolga javob beradigan ko‘ylak: “Pomidorlar...” (ammo qolgan qismi siyqalanib ketgan).
Entries.FringedVest_Description: Yengsiz ko‘ylak ustidan kiyiladigan, popukli jigarrang nimcha.
Entries.GlobbyShirt_Description: Unda ajratib bo‘lmaydigan g‘ujum naqshi bor.
Entries.MidnightDogJacket_Description: Kalmar siyohidan chuqur yarim tun ko‘k rangiga bo‘yalgan.
Entries.ShrimpEnthusiastShirt_Description: Ishtahasi doimiy ravishda krevetka talab qiladiganlar uchun.
Entries.TrinketShirt_Description: Unga katta rangli shisha sharchalar biriktirilgan.
Entries.DarknessSuit_Description: Cho‘ntakdagi xiralashgan qizil ro‘molchali qora kostyum ustki qismi.
Entries.MineralDogJacket_Description: Okeandan olingan iz miqdoridagi minerallar singdirilgan.
Entries.MagentaShirt_Description: Bu rang magma qalpoqchali qo‘ziqoringa xos.
Entries.GingerOveralls_Description: Ranglar uyg‘unligi zanjabil gazli ichimligidan ilhomlangan.
Entries.BananaShirt_Description: Agar bananni yaxshi ko‘rsangiz, shu ko‘ylakni tanlang.
Entries.PrismaticShirt_DarkSleeves_Description: Prizmatik energiya bilan yaltiraydi. To‘q rangli yenglari bor.
Entries.PrismaticShirt_LightSleeves_Description: Prizmatik energiya bilan yaltiraydi. Oq yenglari bor.
